audit_items.proof_trace: Multiple exported Server Actions (`createTeam`, `updateTeam`, `deleteTeam`, `forceLogoutAll`, `forceToggleAttendance`, `deleteTempRegistration`) use `createSupabaseAdminClient()` (service_role, RLS-bypassing) but contain NO authentication or `is_admin` role check before execution. The middleware only verifies presence of an `oauth_user_id` cookie (not its validity or admin role), and `forceLogoutAll` is additionally exposed via `GET /api/admin/force-logout-all` with zero authentication — only a time-window check (JST 22:50-23:50). The only function that enforces `is_admin` in this file is `getTeamWithMembersStatus`, confirming the guard exists but is inconsistently applied.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated non-admin user (or any user with knowledge of the API route during the time window) can invoke `forceToggleAttendance(userId)` as a Server Action to forge attendance records for arbitrary users, or call `GET /api/admin/force-logout-all` without any session cookie during JST 22:50-23:50 to bulk-eject all checked-in members, since neither function verifies the caller's `is_admin` status.
